title: leucothoe subcanescens
intro: Leucothoe subcanescens, commonly known as Whorled Leucothoe or Rabbitear, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the southeastern United States. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Leucothoe subcanescens are attributed to its ability to relax the muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Leucothoe subcanescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
